1.title: How Israel Tried and Failed to Change the Iranian Regime
1.summary: The U.S. and Israel were united in going to war with Iran to change the regime. Mark Mazzetti, a New York Times investigative reporter, explains how the failure of Israel to install Mahmoud Ahmadinejad as Iran’s new leader led the U.S. to narrow its efforts in Iran to just launching attacks with no plan for a new government.

2.title: Moment US Navy jet stuns packed Florida beach with low flypast
2.summary: A US Navy Blue Angels jet sent some beach items up in the air as it flew at a low altitude over a crowd in Pensacola Beach, Florida.

3.title: US military to start screening for testosterone deficiency, Hegseth says
3.summary: Hegseth says he is authorising hormone screening to ensure US troops "operate at your absolute best".

4.title: Global Opinion Shifts Toward Favoring China Over the U.S., Poll Finds
4.summary: An annual survey from the Pew Research Center found that more countries felt positively about China than America.

5.title: Eleven people die in fire at Algerian children's care home
5.summary: Along with the fatalities, 19 people suffered injuries, the authorities say.

6.title: Ukraine’s Minister of Defense, a Proponent of Drone Warfare, Is Forced Out
6.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov announced he was leaving the ministry on Wednesday after conflicts with generals and military contractors over the role of innovative weaponry.
